limitations: There is no guaranteed instant event push from every separate ChatGPT conversation into this repository.
Synchronization is eventual: a plan or coordinator must reconcile recent conversation context and persist the delta.
A conversation that never invokes the shared-state path may remain unseen until a reconciliation pass runs.
